title: Newport at 4:10
logline: The bus stop in Newport, the bench, the schedule in its case, 4:10 on it, no bus. The place she left from, drawn twenty-three years later with nobody on the bench.

panels.composition: A bus stop on a Newport street: a bench, a schedule behind scratched plastic with one departure legible, a trash can, the coast's gray. No bus, no one. The bench's slats worn where people waited.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus stop with an empty bench and a schedule behind scratched plastic where one departure time is legible, a trash can, gray coastal light, no bus, no people, no words
image.notes: Letter after: 4:10 legible; the rest scratched.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
